title: Effective information can peak at a macro scale

statements.text: When effective information is computed at each level under a uniform distribution over that level's own states, a coarse-grained macro level can have more of it than the micro level that fixes it.
statements.scope: effective information as defined by Hoel and colleagues (causal emergence 1.0)

standing.reason: Proposed for integration in the seed proposal, pending the user's review.

sources.quote: EI can nevertheless peak at a macro spatiotemporal scale
EI is also the mutual information (MI) between all possible causes and their effects, MI(UC;UE)
the idea is to calculate the mutual information I(X,Y) between a set of interventions (X) and their effects (Y)
